request: Order ORD-1001 hasn't shipped yet. Investigate why and what we should do.

steps.text: I will look up ORD-1001 to confirm its status, promised delivery date, fulfillment warehouse, and line items so I can determine why it hasn't shipped.
I will check available stock for SKU-202 at WH-BOS to see if a shortage is preventing shipment.
I will search other warehouses for SKU-202 that can alone cover the 38-unit shortfall so we can decide on a transfer.

arguments.summary: Order ORD-1001 has not shipped because WH-BOS only has 12 available of 50 ordered for SKU-202, leaving a 38-unit shortfall and risking a missed ship-by date if not resolved. WH-CHI can alone cover the 38 needed units via a stock transfer.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1001 fulfillment_status PENDING_FULFILLMENT at WH-BOS (Boston Distribution Center), promised_delivery_date 2026-03-19, ship_by_date 2026-03-17, items include SKU-202 quantity 50.
check_inventory: SKU-202 at WH-BOS on_hand 12, reserved 0, available 12 (ordered 50) → shortfall 38.
find_alternative_stock: required_quantity 38; WH-CHI available 80, can_cover_required_quantity true; WH-ATL available 30, cannot cover; WH-DAL available 0, cannot cover.
arguments.likely_cause: Insufficient stock at the fulfillment warehouse (WH-BOS has only 12 available vs. 50 ordered for SKU-202).
uncertainties: Lead time for transferring 38 units from WH-CHI to WH-BOS and whether it can meet the 2026-03-17 ship-by date.
Whether the customer accepts split shipments (12 now, 38 later).

recommended_actions.details: Transfer 38 units of SKU-202 from WH-CHI to WH-BOS immediately to cover the shortfall for ORD-1001; supported by check_inventory showing only 12 available at WH-BOS (shortfall 38) and find_alternative_stock showing WH-CHI available 80 and can_cover_required_quantity true for 38.

Ship the 12 units available at WH-BOS now and ship the remaining 38 after the transfer to reduce the risk of missing the 2026-03-17 ship-by date; supported by check_inventory showing available 12 and get_order_details showing ship_by_date 2026-03-17.

Inform Northwind Retail that SKU-202 is short by 38 units at WH-BOS (check_inventory) and that the remainder will ship after a transfer from WH-CHI (find_alternative_stock). Set expectations around potential delivery impact relative to the 2026-03-19 promise (get_order_details).

arguments.recommendation: Transfer 38 units of SKU-202 from WH-CHI to WH-BOS, ship the 12 units now as a partial, and notify the customer about the plan and potential delivery impact.
